items.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
items.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。

items.title: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
items.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. items.title: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
items.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
items.summary: OpenAI has significantly strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. In adaptive red-teaming tests, the success rate for extracting protected reasoning fell from 54 percent to 0.2 percent. The company is also suspending thousands to tens of thousands of accounts each week over coordinated distillation campaigns. The article OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 大幅加強了防護措施，防止從 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 中提取內部推理。在自適應紅隊測試中，提取受保護推理的成功率從 54% 下降至 0.2%。該公司還因協同蒸餾活動每週停權數千到數萬個帳戶。

items_ai.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
items_ai.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。
